row.description: The U.S. Standard Form 424 naming convention may append an optional parenthesized revision month and year, such as SF-424 (Rev. 12/2022).

neighbors.distinction: Identifies an information-collection approval, commonly in a 1234-5678 pattern.
Names a related budget-information form rather than a revision of SF-424.

row.wrong_generalization: Requiring a revision mark because every sampled PDF happens to show one would reject valid base form labels; allowing arbitrary parenthetical prose would lose the controlled revision-date structure.
